descriptionMarkdown:
Produces 10.5k science per minute for red/green/gray/blue/purple/yellow science. the rest can be imported via train.

Input trains : 

* Molten copper
* Molten Iron
* Crude Oil
* Stone Ore
* Coal Ore
* white/orange/pink/blue/black Science

Note : 

all trains are 2-8.
You can increase maximum capacity by increasing the amount of Biolabs or increasing their quality.
title: [Quality][Nauvis] Science City block
